To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
customer satisfaction toward SD practices is higher when these practices are adopted in large hotels and in chain affiliated hotels.

Customer satisfaction is positively influenced in the hospitality industry by the hotel's SD practices, and that the level of customer's satisfaction with these practices is higher in small and medium sized independent hotels.

customer satisfaction in the hotel industry is positively influenced by hotel's adoption of sustainable development practices, and that the level of customer's satisfaction varies according to hotel's size and ownership type.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the antecedents, and the moderating effect of the hotel's size, of customer satisfaction toward SD practices in the hospitality sector.

the antecedents and the impact of customer satisfaction in relation to the SD practices implemented by hotels, and the impact of the hotel's size, and type of ownership on the customer's perception of the SD practices.
the impact of hotel SD practices on customer satisfaction.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the adoption of SD practices in the hospitality sector is positively related to customer satisfaction, and this relationship is moderated by the size and type of hotel ownership.
the adoption of SD practices by the hotel industry is an important factor for increasing customer satisfaction.

customer satisfaction toward SD practices is higher in large independent hotels than in small and medium independent hotels, in large chain affiliated hotels than in small chain affiliated hotels, and in large independent hotels compared to small chain affiliated hotels.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the hotel industry is a very important industry for sustainable development and that the hotel industry can be a very important part of the solution to many of the problems that the world faces today.

the adoption of SD practices by hotels is an important determinant of customer satisfaction, which in turn is positively related to customers' intentions to return to the hotel and to recommend it to friends.
the adoption of sustainable development practices in the hotel industry is a key factor in customer satisfaction.
The main takeaway from our work is that
hotel managers need to pay attention to the adoption of SD practices in order to improve their customers' satisfaction and their intention to revisit the hotel.
hotels should adopt SD practices as a way of increasing customer satisfaction.
the hospitality industry should continue its efforts to adopt and promote SD practices.
